note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after rfc4301_outbound_steps_linux_test.go changed. RFC 4301 Section 5.1 step 3a: "If there is a match, then process the packet as specified by the matching cache entry, i.e., BYPASS, DISCARD, or PROTECT using AH or ESP." TestRFC4301OutboundPacketTakesTheDispositionOfTheEntryItMatches asserts PROTECT (ESP arriving at remote endpoint carrying child.OutboundSPI, XfrmOutNoStates unchanged) and BYPASS (clear delivery, no ESP on raw socket). TestRFC4301OutboundPacketIsDiscardedByTheEntryItMatches asserts operator DISCARD (EPERM, XfrmOutPolBlock +1, not delivered) and catch-all DISCARD on an unmatched port. Verdict stands.
